sources.title: o4-mini-deep-research model reference
sources.evidence: Read the complete exact-model Markdown reference. It binds the alias to o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26 and documents 200,000 context, 100,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens, file uploads, prompt caching and hosted research tools. Both alias and snapshot are marked Shut down. No learned-parameter count or detailed topology is supplied. Reopened on October 27 for the parameter re-audit: neither a nominal total nor an active-parameter count is provided.

sources.title: Introducing deep research: April 24, 2025 update
sources.evidence: The April 24 addendum explicitly introduces a new lightweight deep research version powered by a version of o4-mini, with automatic switching after full-version limits and access for Free users. The original February launch and its benchmark/training discussion describe the earlier o3 research model; they are not exact o4-mini research specifications. Reopened the April 24 addendum on October 27: the named o4-mini variant relationship is explicit, but neither variant nor base size is stated.

sources.title: Deep research in the API, webhooks, and web search with o3
sources.evidence: The June 26, 2025 first announcement post explicitly identifies o3-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research as the same research models already available in ChatGPT, now in the API. Independently read the topic JSON and verified author Nikunj Handa, OpenAI Staff title and administrator flag. This binds the product lineage without proving identical April and June checkpoint weights.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog: June 2025
sources.evidence: The current changelog places the release of both research API models under June 24, while listing June 26 snapshot identifiers. This differs from the dated June 26 contemporary API announcement. The audit records the conflict instead of deriving API availability solely from a snapshot suffix.

sources.title: Deep research API guide
sources.evidence: The historical guide names the exact model and documents web search, file search, code interpreter and specialized MCP search/fetch servers. Other tools, including custom function calling, are unsupported. Its retirement notice says the examples are retained for reference after July 23, 2026, not evidence of a working endpoint.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: The archived recipe explicitly applies only to models before GPT-5.6. Section 2.1 describes prompt caching in Transformer layers and attention key/value projections. Together with exact o4-mini-deep-research prompt-caching support, this supports a qualified broad Transformer inference; it does not establish dense/MoE structure or any parameter count.

sources.title: File inputs API guide
sources.evidence: PDF parsing passes extracted text and page images to models with vision capabilities. The exact model reference separately establishes image input and file uploads. PDF is therefore an API input format, not an additional native encoder or a retroactive April ChatGPT specification.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: The April 22, 2026 July-shutdown notice explicitly lists both o4-mini-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26 as shut down on July 23, 2026. This corroborates the current exact model reference; no endpoint request was made.

sources.title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the full April 16, 2025 card on October 27, including Section 2 training and a full-text count search. It describes base o3 and o4-mini, but gives no nominal total or active parameter count. The launch establishes named o4-mini variant lineage; there is no supported base count here to inherit.

sources.title: Deep Research System Card, February 25, 2025
sources.evidence: Downloaded the full original research card and inspected its model and training scope. It identifies an early o3 research variant plus a separate o3-mini chain-of-thought summarizer, with no o4-mini-deep-research name. Its original model parameters or training details cannot be treated as those of the later lightweight variant. The October 27 reread of its introduction and training section and full-text count search confirms the earlier o3 scope and supplies no count for the later o4-mini research variant.

sources.title: ChatGPT Agent System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded the full July 17, 2025 report and inspected Table 6 and model/training references. The Deep research comparison column contains multilingual performance, not parameter counts, and does not identify the lightweight o4-mini variant. No exact o4-mini-deep-research count or topology appears in the extracted text. Reopened Table 6 and the full-text model/count matches on October 27; the comparison is performance only.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and extracted the complete OpenAI-authored card; inspected model progressions, training, the o4-mini comparison sections and exact-variant/count/topology search matches. The retrieved revision is May 1, 2026. It compares base o4-mini, not an exact o4-mini-deep-research parameter column, and supplies no count or topology disclosure for the research variant. Reopened the May 1, 2026 revision on October 27; the o4-mini succession and benchmark sections contain no nominal total or active-count convention for this research variant.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded the full later report, inspected Table 1 architecture/counts and the o4-mini comparison figures/tables. Parameter counts belong to gpt-oss; o4-mini columns report performance. The exact research-variant name is absent. Neither gpt-oss architecture nor base o4-mini capabilities establish this variant's internals. Reopened Table 1 on October 27: its active and total rows explicitly cover only gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, not o4-mini or its research variant.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Read sections 2.2 and 9.1. The terms grant limited hosted-service access and reserve service intellectual property. Alongside the model reference and release, this supports the descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open-weight license or a claim about ownership of generated outputs.

sources.title: Models.dev o4-mini-deep-research record
sources.evidence: Inspected the upstream lead, which uses June 26 API release, o-mini grouping, text/image input, tools, reasoning and 200K context. Primary sources independently establish the corrected fields.

sources.title: o4-mini model reference
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete official model reference and its freshly fetched Markdown on October 27. It identifies o4-mini-2025-04-16 and describes a small o-series model with text/image input, but publishes neither nominal total nor active parameters. The named research-variant relationship therefore has no supported base size from which to infer a count.

sources.title: DeepSearchQA: Bridging the Comprehensiveness Gap for Deep Research Agents
sources.publisher: Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Search and Kaggle
sources.evidence: Reopened the original December 11, 2025 paper on October 27 and inspected Table 4 on PDF page 8. Its exact o4 Mini Deep Research row reports Fully Correct, Fully Incorrect, Correct with Extraneous Answers and F1 metrics. The table has no total or activated-parameter column; the full text supplies no nominal count for this model.

sources.title: Tongyi DeepResearch Technical Report, November 15, 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened the original report on October 27, including the abstract, Section 4.1, Table 1 and bibliography. Its 30.5B total and 3.3B activated counts are Tongyi DeepResearch specifications. Table 1 contains benchmark performance columns; base OpenAI o4-mini is a separate ReAct row, while OpenAI DeepResearch cites the February o3 research card. Neither row establishes an o4-mini-deep-research total or active count.

name.note: Exact undated API model alias, distinct from base o4-mini and o3-deep-research; default snapshot is o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26.

developer.note: OpenAI published the exact hosted model reference and both public release announcements.

family.note: The release explicitly identifies an o4-mini variant. Use o4 as the catalog generation grouping within the broader o-series; this is not an assertion of unchanged weights or topology.

release_date.note: Earliest public availability of the lightweight o4-mini research variant in ChatGPT. The later API announcement directly binds its API name to the ChatGPT research models. June snapshot identity and API specifications are not backdated to April. The current June 24 changelog and June 26 announcement disagree on API launch day.

open_weights.note: The documented distribution is hosted ChatGPT/API service access; the inspected primary release/reference provide no downloadable checkpoint or open-weight grant.

license.note: Supported descriptive classification for the hosted model under OpenAI service terms, not an SPDX identifier.

parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit: no supported nominal total was found for the exact research variant or its explicitly named o4-mini base. The April 24 release establishes variant lineage, but no disclosed base count is available to inherit. Fresh exact-name total/count searches and original/later reports, including Google DeepSearchQA and Tongyi DeepResearch, yielded performance comparisons rather than a parameter specification; an exact tensor census is not required.

active_parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit separately searched active/activated parameter counts and later original model-team comparisons. Google DeepSearchQA Table 4 identifies the exact research variant but reports accuracy/F1; Tongyi Table 1 reports benchmark scores and does not identify this exact variant. OpenAI later reports provide no applicable active-count convention. Neither the named o4-mini lineage nor price, model size labels or dense-equals-total assumptions supplies a supported active count.

architecture.note: Qualified broad inference from exact-model prompt-caching support and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation of Transformer attention layers. Targeted first-party exact-variant training/interpretability searches and the checked reports did not establish dense/MoE structure, layers, experts or full multimodal topology. No base-model internals are transferred.

context_window.note: Last documented API context in tokens for the June 26 snapshot, separate from the 100,000-token output cap. Not asserted for the April ChatGPT deployment; the API model is retired.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is an API file format converted into extracted text and page images. Generated Python plots and retrieved web images are tool artifacts, not native image output; no audio/video capability is established.

reasoning.note: The exact API reference documents reasoning-token support, and the API changelog identifies the research model as an o-series reasoning variant.

tool_call.note: True for the documented web search, file search, code interpreter and constrained MCP search/fetch calls. Custom function calling and arbitrary MCP interfaces are unsupported. These are historical documented capabilities, not current endpoint-operation claims.

description.value: OpenAI o4-mini variant for multi-step web research and data analysis, with text and image input and cited text reports.
description.note: States the supported research specialization and modalities without unqualified comparative quality claims; historical availability and input-format details are in the notes.

patch.notes: First publicly released as the lightweight o4-mini research variant in ChatGPT on April 24, 2025. OpenAI's later API announcement identifies o4-mini-deep-research as that ChatGPT research offering; identical April and June checkpoints are not assumed. The API changelog gives June 24 while the contemporaneous API announcement is dated June 26. The context and tool/input specifications are last documented for o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26; OpenAI shut down the alias and snapshot on July 23, 2026. Tool support means web search, file search, code interpreter and specialized MCP search/fetch; custom function calling is unsupported. PDF is an API input format converted to text and page images, and tool-generated figures are not native image output. Transformer is a broad inference from exact-model caching support and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation. Dense/MoE structure remains undisclosed. No supported nominal total or active parameter count was found for this variant or its named o4-mini base; later research comparisons report performance only.

summary: Corrected earliest release to the April 24, 2025 lightweight ChatGPT research launch using explicit later API identity evidence, while retaining the June API-date conflict and later snapshot scope. Corrected family to o4, added Proprietary licensing, qualified Transformer inference and PDF input-format support, and clarified the description. Confirmed historical context, reasoning and constrained research-tool support; documented July 23, 2026 shutdown. October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after reopening the named o4-mini lineage and original reports, fresh count searches, and later Google DeepSearchQA/Tongyi comparison checks; no supported base count or exact-variant active convention was found.
